captions.zh: 宇宙会如何终结？
captions.en: How will the universe end?

captions.zh: 不是轰然一声巨响
captions.en: Not with a bang

captions.zh: 而是一声呜咽
captions.en: but a whimper

captions.zh: 1865 年，克劳修斯提出了一个概念——熵
captions.en: 1865 · Rudolf Clausius names a new quantity: entropy

captions.zh: 它衡量一个系统有多么“混乱”
captions.en: A measure of disorder

captions.zh: 热力学第二定律：孤立系统的熵，永不减少
captions.en: The second law: in an isolated system, entropy never decreases

captions.zh: 热量从高温流向低温，这股流动可以做功
captions.en: Heat flows from hot to cold — and that flow can do work

captions.zh: 可一旦处处温度相同，一切流动都将停止
captions.en: But once everything is the same temperature, all flow stops

captions.zh: 而宇宙，就是最大的孤立系统
captions.en: And the universe is the ultimate isolated system

captions.zh: 它注定走向的终点——
captions.en: Its inevitable destination —

captions.zh: 今天，宇宙 138 亿岁，群星璀璨
captions.en: Today the universe is 13.8 billion years old, ablaze with stars

captions.zh: 恒星燃烧核燃料，把有序的能量化作无序的光和热
captions.en: Stars burn nuclear fuel, turning ordered energy into disordered light and heat

captions.zh: 每一缕星光，都在推高宇宙的熵
captions.en: Every ray of starlight raises the entropy of the cosmos

captions.zh: 与此同时，宇宙正在加速膨胀
captions.en: Meanwhile, space itself is expanding — faster and faster

captions.zh: 约 1000 亿年后，本星系群以外的星系，都将退出我们的视界
captions.en: In ~100 billion years, every galaxy beyond our Local Group slips past the horizon

captions.zh: 星际气体终将耗尽，新的恒星不再诞生
captions.en: The gas runs out. No new stars are born

captions.zh: 大质量恒星，在超新星爆发中死去
captions.en: Massive stars die in supernova explosions

captions.zh: 最长寿的红矮星，也只能燃烧约十万亿年
captions.en: Even the longest-lived red dwarfs burn for only ~10 trillion years

captions.zh: 10¹⁴ 年，最后一颗恒星熄灭
captions.en: 10¹⁴ years: the last star goes out

captions.zh: 宇宙只剩下恒星的残骸：白矮星、中子星、黑洞
captions.en: Only stellar corpses remain: white dwarfs, neutron stars, black holes

captions.zh: 偶然的近距离交会，把恒星一颗颗抛出星系
captions.en: Rare close encounters fling stars out of the galaxy, one by one

captions.zh: 如果质子会衰变，物质本身也将瓦解
captions.en: If protons decay, matter itself will dissolve
captions.note: 质子寿命的实验下限：> 10³⁴ 年

captions.zh: 原子化作光子、正电子与中微子
captions.en: Atoms break down into photons, positrons and neutrinos

captions.zh: 10⁴⁰ 年，普通物质荡然无存
captions.en: 10⁴⁰ years: ordinary matter is gone

captions.zh: 宇宙进入黑洞纪元
captions.en: The universe enters the Black Hole Era

captions.zh: 黑洞，成了宇宙中最后的天体
captions.en: Black holes are the last objects left

captions.zh: 但它们，也并非永恒
captions.en: But even they are not forever

captions.zh: 霍金辐射：黑洞会极其缓慢地蒸发
captions.en: Hawking radiation: black holes slowly evaporate

captions.zh: 太阳质量的黑洞需要 10⁶⁷ 年，最大的黑洞约需 10¹⁰⁰ 年
captions.en: A solar-mass black hole takes 10⁶⁷ years; the largest, about 10¹⁰⁰

captions.zh: 黑洞越小，温度越高，蒸发得越快
captions.en: The smaller it gets, the hotter it burns — and the faster it goes

captions.zh: 10¹⁰⁰ 年，最后一个黑洞在闪光中消失
captions.en: 10¹⁰⁰ years: the last black hole vanishes in a flash

captions.zh: 宇宙只剩下稀薄的光子与轻子
captions.en: All that remains is a thin haze of photons and leptons

captions.zh: 它们彼此相隔遥远，几乎永不相遇
captions.en: So far apart they will almost never meet

captions.zh: 温度无限趋近绝对零度，处处相同
captions.en: The temperature sinks toward absolute zero — the same everywhere

captions.zh: 没有温差，就没有流动；没有变化，时间也失去意义
captions.en: No difference, no flow. No change — time loses its meaning

captions.zh: 但此刻，宇宙才 138 亿岁
captions.en: But right now, the universe is only 13.8 billion years old

captions.zh: 如果宇宙的一生长达 10¹⁰⁰ 年，今天只走到了它的 10⁻⁹⁰
captions.en: If its life spans 10¹⁰⁰ years, today is just 10⁻⁹⁰ of the way in

captions.zh: 我们，正活在宇宙最明亮、最温暖的一瞬
captions.en: We live in the brightest, warmest instant the universe will ever know

captions.zh: 抬头看看星空吧——趁群星依然闪耀
captions.en: So look up — while the stars still shine
